candidates.issues: All ingredients are in the nominative case rather than the required genitive case after quantities (e.g., should be 'сливочного масла', 'сахара', etc.). Did not convert 350 Fahrenheit to Celsius (175°C), which is crucial for Russian readers.

The title 'Брауни с плотной влажной текстурой' is overly long and descriptive rather than a natural recipe name. Same grammatical issues in the ingredient list (lack of genitive case) and no temperature conversion.

Left the inches symbol '8”' instead of translating to cm or spelling out 'дюймов'. 'Хлопьевидная морская соль' sounds unnatural compared to 'морская соль в хлопьях'. Same ingredient grammar and temperature issues.
Uses 'до полного растворения' (until dissolved) instead of melted; chocolate melts rather than dissolves. Same ingredient grammar and temperature issues.
